description: Search the library of exact real-object geometry (fasteners, extrusion, sanitary fittings, electronics boards, phones and devices, motors, mounts, tri-clamp caps, inserts, pistons, linkages and frames) by name or keyword. Use it when you know what the thing is called; use find_by_dimensions when you only have measurements, list_categories to learn filter values. Every query word must appear in the object's name, aliases or tags (case-insensitive; '80-40', '80x40' and '8040' match alike); filters narrow with AND. Returns 20 summaries per page (limit up to 100) with total and next_offset for paging; an empty result means nothing matched every word, so retry with fewer words.

category.description: Exact category name from list_categories, e.g. 'Hardware'.

free_only.description: Only objects whose files are free to download.

group.description: Exact group name within a category from list_categories, e.g. 'Fasteners'.

kind.description: modern/vintage = a product; standard = a part defined by a standard; hardware = a generated part with free files.

les_only.description: Only parts used in Long Earth Society builds.

offset.description: Start index; pass next_offset from the previous page.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'M3 heat set insert', 'tri clamp ferrule 2in', 'raspberry pi 5'. Omit to list by filters alone.

year.description: Release year for products: '2023', '2020s' or '2010-2019'; objects without a year are then excluded.

name: find_geometry
title: Search objects by name
